Leviticus; Num 7:16 19 t. Numbers; עִזִּים שְׂעִירַת a single she-goat Lev 4:28 ; 5:6 ; זִּים עְפִרֵי 2Chr 29:21 he-goats. 4 עִזִּים = goats' hair, as material 1Sam 19:13 , 16 ; Exod 25:4 6 t. P ( 35:26 object of טָווּ !). 5 in simile עִזִּים חֲשַׂפֵי 1Kin 20:27 (see [ חָשִׂיף ]); הָע ׳כְּעֵדַר Song 4:1 ; 6:5 , of flowing, undulating hair. 6 הָע ׳צְפִיר Du Song 8:5 , 8 he-goat in vision. ענז (√ of following; see Biblical Hebrew עֵז ענז, ).
